## Gaps

- Pages with a status other than ok: 0
- Per-operation reference pages under `api-docs.solidgate.com/api/...` (their own sitemap) are NOT mirrored; the contract comes from the OpenAPI files (`openapi/v1.yaml`, `openapi/v2.yaml`).
